newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS view cut.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it trimmed its earnings estimates on Intel Corp but maintained its hold rating on the stock.
-- analyst Erika Klauer said she cut the 1997 earnings estimate to $8.50 a share from $8.90, and trimmed the 1998 estimate to $9.50 from $10.
-- said continues to appreciate Intel's long-term fundamentals.
-- said Intel "cannot shift fast enough to its newer products to meet demand."
-- said, "We have continually cited this as a key risk to the Intel story and are not surprised by (Intel's) announcement."
-- said expects Intel will have to offer greater price discounts on older products to stimulate demand, especially if typical seasonal slowness occurs.
-- Early today Intel said revenues and net income for its fiscal second quarter will fall below its expectations due to weaker-than-expected demand, particularly in Europe.
